data.title: Upgrade Defense | Dungeon Defenders Wiki | Fandom
data.description: Upgrade Defense is a hero action that allows players to spend mana to upgrade a nearby defense, increasing its stats and fully repairing it. The action's default hotkey is [5] on PC. A single defense can be upgraded up to five times, with every level requiring more mana and a longer casting...

data.title: Mana - Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki
data.description: Blue mana is used to activate Hero Abilities and Green mana is used to Build, Repair and Upgrade defenses. This system is based off of Dungeon Defenders 1, where there was only one type of mana, and that mana would be used to both activate abilities and build towers.

data.title: Needs more mana. :: Dungeon Defenders II General Discussions
data.description: The mana you get from enemies is very low, but it's also very intentional. There's a few key things to keep in mind: 1) upgrades are cheap. The first one is 50 (!) mana. Repairing a defense from half costs 15-20, so if you skip repairing stuff and upgrade instead, you get the better end of the deal (upgrades trigger a full repair) 2) upgrading a tower is more valuable than building a new one ...

data.title: Defenses - Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki
data.description: Formula: Total Green Mana Cost * 75% * % of missing health A Defense will sell for green mana based on its condition and upgrade status. A Defense sold in the same build phase it was built in will give a full refund, including any green mana spent on upgrades.
